name: olmOCR-2-7B-1025

lineage.how_derived: fine-tuned on olmOCR-mix-1025, then GRPO on olmOCR-synthmix-1025

purpose: Convert page images to plain text at scale for research and educational use, tuned for math, tables and hard OCR cases.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: allenai/olmocr GitHub LICENSE read is the unmodified Apache-2.0 text, card agrees; the card adds "intended for research and educational use in accordance with Ai2 Responsible Use Guidelines", a statement of intent, not a license term

architecture.why_this_design: RL targets math, tables and hard OCR; the olmOCR toolkit does rendering, rotation and retries (card).

pc-12gb.notes: 8B at Q4 about 5 GB, vision tower and page tokens add more

engine_support.notes: Qwen2.5-VL is supported in llama.cpp (docs/multimodal.md); GGUF of olmOCR 2 itself not confirmed

strengths: FP8 gives the same score as BF16 (82.3 vs 82.4)
although described as English-focused, third-party German pages score 75.7 (MDPBench), better than Qwen3-VL-8B (73.7)
weaknesses: about eight times larger than the 1B parsers with no clear gain
soft.maturity: Ai2 is a research institute with fully open releases

tona_fit.reason: raised from reject: the English-only assumption does not hold in third-party tests (German 75.7), Apache-2.0 verified, strongest bulk-batch tooling; still 7B and outscored by the 1B parsers on German (GLM-OCR 82.7, PaddleOCR-VL 84.8), so it is not first choice

sources.note: MDPBench README table read directly; an earlier summarizer pass mislabeled the Latin-average column as DE, the DE values here come from the dataset README
